business_summary.text: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank has proactively provided ₹304.24 Cr towards its estimated ECL requirement of ₹385 Cr as on September 30, 2026, recognizing nearly 80% of the requirement well ahead of the regulatory timeline. The ECL framework becomes applicable from April 1, 2027.

call_points.text: Management increased FY27 deposit growth guidance to 20%+ and advances growth guidance to 22%+.
call_points.versus_prior: raised from 16% deposit and 20% advances growth guidance

call_points.text: NIM for the rest of the year is guided at 4.10% plus/minus 5 basis points.
Cost-to-income ratio is guided to remain well below 44% for the year.
NIM is expected to be defended in the 3.9% to 4.0% range in FY27.
Cost-to-income ratio is committed to remain below 50%, expected around 46%-47% range.
Hardening G-Sec yields and inflation due to energy prices are key macro factors to watch.
Network broadened with 44 new branches opened during FY26, including 15 branches in non-Tamil Nadu states.
Board recommended a dividend of 125% for FY2026, subject to shareholder approval.

guidance.statement: We are saying that in FY27, we will grow at least 1% higher than what we did in FY26 (deposit growth around 16%).
The advances that we did of 20% is something that we will defend in the current year as well.
We are still looking at a 1.9% to 2% kind of ROA for FY27.
Cost-to-income ratio will remain below 50% and should be in the 46%, 47% range.
Deposits growth will be 20% plus in FY27
Advances growth will be 22% plus in FY27

operating_notes.text: Provision coverage ratio stood at 74.89% without technical write-offs and 96.14% with technical write-offs as of March 31, 2026.
The Bank continues to hold a COVID-19 contingency provision of ₹250.00 Cr on advances as of March 31, 2026.
Gold loan portfolio stood at ₹24,790 Cr representing 46.44% of total advances with average LTV of 53.25% as of March 31, 2026.
MSME advances grew 14.88% YoY in Q4 FY26 with a yield of 10.52% and ROA of 2.58%.
Income tax demand for AY 2013-14 reduced from ₹204.23 Cr to ₹2.93 Cr via rectification order dated May 14, 2026.
Bank revised MCLR effective June 7, 2026, increasing overnight, one-month, three-month, and six-month rates by 5 bps each, while holding one-year MCLR at 9.25%.
Recognized ₹93.68 Cr from PSLC sales in other income during H1FY27 on a straight-line basis out of total ₹244.67 Cr realized.
Reversed ₹15.45 Cr penalty provision in Q2FY27 following SAFEMA Appellate Tribunal order reducing penalty to ₹3.40 Cr.
Made incremental standard asset provision of ₹28.88 Cr during Q2FY27 over regulatory requirement.
Provided 100% for SMA 1 and SMA 2 as per ECL norms during Q2FY27.
Provided ₹304.24 Cr towards estimated ECL requirement of ₹385 Cr as on September 30, 2026, representing 80% of the requirement ahead of regulatory timeline
